# Moldex3D 2025

## Required build

- Product: Moldex3D 2025 64-bit
- Installed product version: `2025.0.2507.1715.5424`
- MDXStudio ProductVersion: `2025.1.2506.8697`

## Purchase and download

1. Purchase the required Moldex3D 2025 commercial modules through [Moldex3D sales](https://www.moldex3d.com/about/contact-information/).
2. Register the licensed user and machine details with CoreTech or the authorized regional reseller.
3. Obtain the customer download link for the Moldex3D 2025 64-bit build `2025.0.2507.1715.5424`.
4. Download the complete Windows installation media from that customer link.
5. Retain the original installer securely for future reinstalls.

The public [Moldex3D downloads page](https://www.moldex3d.com/support/downloads/) distributes the Viewer and language packs. CoreTech supplies the commercial product installer through the licensed customer channel.

## Install and activate

1. Run the Moldex3D 2025 installer as Administrator.
2. Install the Moldex3D License Manager supplied with the purchased entitlement.
3. Configure the purchased node-locked or network entitlement in Moldex3D License Manager.
4. Start Moldex3D Studio and confirm that the purchased modules open.
5. Keep credentials, activation data, and license files outside this repository.

## Verify

Run the `verify` command in `meta.json`. It checks `C:\Moldex3D\2025\Bin\MDXStudio.exe` and the pinned ProductVersion.
